Name: Penny's bob (compatible with Seasonal Outfits)
Author: virgogirl69
Description:
I saw [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7093?tab=description]wolffang719's Penny mod[/url]﻿ and, despite knowing nothing about RWBY, fell completely in love with her hairstyle! I've added it to all of her outfits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] with wolffang719's permission. All you have to do is replace the Penny folder in Characters and Portraits with these new ones.

Note that some of the outfits are switched around from their usual slots in Seasonal Outfits (for example, I've switched her Fall and Fair outfits); however, this is easy to fix if you prefer, as you can just change the file names around in your folder.

This is my first ever mod upload for any game, so please be kind! <3
